convert_smplx_motion_to_habitat: convert a SMPL-X npz motion file to a Habitat-compatible pkl file using MotionConverterSMPLX
convert_single_pose_to_rotation: convert a single SMPL-X pose to Habitat format with corrected root translation and joint rotations
compute_global_correction_quaternion: compute a correction quaternion to align a local space frame to global space with Y up and Z forward
load_humanoid_urdf_in_pybullet: load a humanoid URDF into PyBullet and extract joint information for SMPL-X joint mapping
review_smplx_joint_names: review the list of SMPL-X body joint names including body, face, hand, and expression joints
